run_sampling_cli: run the sampling CLI to generate text from a RecurrentGemma checkpoint and tokenizer
create_sampler: create a Sampler with a Griffin model and SentencePiece tokenizer for text generation
build_griffin_model: build a Griffin model from a GriffinConfig derived from torch checkpoint parameters
create_griffin_config: create a GriffinConfig from torch checkpoint params using a preset like RECURRENT_GEMMA_2B_V1
test_load_and_sample: test the _load_and_sample function that loads a checkpoint and samples text from it
